periods.time: Morning at the Guild before Denatus, three days after Bell's level-up

name.en: Bell Reports Level 2 at the Guild

periods.summary: Bell Cranel arrives at the crowded Guild in high spirits and tells Eina Tulle that he reached Lv.2 three days earlier. Because he has been an adventurer for only about one and a half months, both Eina and Misha react with stunned disbelief.
periods.cause: Bell defeated the Minotaur and received a level-up shortly before the start of volume 4; he visits his Guild advisor to report the change.
periods.process: Eina, already worried by rumors of Minotaurs in the upper floors and by Bell's recent silence, relaxes when Bell appears. Bell happily says he has reached Lv.2; Misha drops her documents, and Eina verifies the timing before shouting in shock.
periods.outcome: Bell's unprecedented growth speed becomes a personal shock to the Guild staff who know his beginner status.
periods.aftermath: The scene frames Bell as the 'fastest' young adventurer and sets up attention around his new status before the gods' meeting.
periods.significance: Establishes Bell's Lv.2 status at the start of volume 4 and highlights how abnormal his growth rate appears to Guild personnel.
